plan.concept: Visualizing the RANSAC algorithm's consensus step where 8 inliers (including two defining red points) are identified near a candidate model line.
plan.layout: single panel labeled (e) at the bottom center

panels.label: (e)

series.label: fitted line
series.note: A thick red line representing the model candidate passing exactly through the two red points.

series.label: defining points
series.note: Two key points highlighted in red with black borders, used to define the RANSAC line.

series.label: inliers
series.note: Inlier points within the RANSAC threshold, colored sky blue with black borders.

series.label: outliers
series.note: Outlier points, represented as white circles with black borders.

panels.nodeDecorations: Points have a solid black outline (~1.5px). Defining points are filled with vibrant red, inliers with sky blue, and outliers are hollow (white fill).

plan.reconstructionNotes: Ensure the axes meet at an offset origin to show the start of the arrows properly. The vertical Y-axis has an arrowhead at the top, and the horizontal X-axis has an arrowhead at the right. The line is defined analytically by the two red points (1.0, 3.0) and (7.0, 6.9). The text '8 inliers' should be positioned centered above the line.
